name: workproof
description: Guardrails that enforce instead of advise: a secret guard for shell, Docker, file tools and commits; per-project plans whose stages close only on a command that passes; agent roles with model limits; commit rules; a flow map kept true by its tests; a watcher for long runs; and skills for delivery, Docker, Rust and button layout. Each module switches on or off in the plugin options.

secret_guard.title: Secret guard module
secret_guard.description: Block Bash and PowerShell commands that read or print secrets, Docker commands that leak them, the Read, Grep and Edit tools on a secret file, and commits that stage secrets.

extra_secret_names.title: Extra secret file names
extra_secret_names.description: File name patterns to guard besides the built-in list, separated by commas or new lines. A * stays inside one folder, ** crosses folders, and a pattern matches the end of a path: *.vault, deploy/keys/**, .my-token

proof_plans.title: Proof plans module
proof_plans.description: Print the project's plan at every session start; a stage closed on a passing command is marked verified, one closed on a written proof unverified.

plans_root.title: Plans root
plans_root.description: Optional folder that holds many projects. When set, the session-start hook also lists the other active plans under it (up to three folders deep). Leave empty to see only the current project's plan.

agent_roles.title: Agent roles module
agent_roles.description: Five agents by activity (implementer, reviewer, debugger, designer, runner) with the delegating skill; a call that asks one of them for a model above its default asks you first.

refuse_inheriting_agents.title: Refuse agents on the session's model
refuse_inheriting_agents.description: Refuse general-purpose, fork, Plan and Explore agents unless the call names haiku or sonnet, since they otherwise run on the session's (often most expensive) model.

ui_conventions.title: Button layout module
ui_conventions.description: A skill for placing, sizing and styling the buttons of any screen, dialog, form or game menu.

buttons_positive_trailing_everywhere.title: Confirm buttons trailing on Windows too
buttons_positive_trailing_everywhere.description: Put confirming actions on the trailing side on Windows as well, instead of the platform's leading affirmative button.

delivery.title: Delivery module
delivery.description: Skills for closing a delivery (proof, clean machine, documents, plan, commits, report) and for keeping CLAUDE.md files, rules and skills right.

rust.title: Rust module
rust.description: A skill for a short Rust build and test loop.

docker.title: Docker module
docker.description: A skill for building, testing and running Docker Compose systems in throwaway projects.

long_runs.title: Long runs module
long_runs.description: Watch long background runs with the watch_run tool and the watch-log command, and show the running-long-commands skill.

compact_on_stage_close.title: Compact on stage close
compact_on_stage_close.description: When work-plan done closes a stage in the main session, and the plan repository is committed with a stage still pending, compact the conversation at the end of that turn. Needs the proof plans module.

flow_map.title: Flow map module
flow_map.description: Keep each project flow map (docs/FLOWS.md) true: the check-flows engine recomputes every flow status from the tests and screenshots it cites, and two skills teach the method.
